He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Wisconsin Badgers men's basketball|Wisconsin Badgers]]. ==Early life== Davis is the son of former NBA player [[Mark Davis (basketball, born 1963)|Mark Davis]].{{cite web |title=Chesapeake native, ODU product Davis now watches sons shine on court |url=https://www.wtkr.com/sports/chesapeake-native-odu-product-davis-now-watches-sons-shine-on-court |website=News 3 WTKR Norfolk |access-date=25 June 2025 |language=en |date=23 March 2022}} He played basketball for [[La Crosse Central High School]] in [[La Crosse, Wisconsin]]. He helped the school win a Division 2 state title as a freshman.{{cite web |title=No. 1: La Crosse Central boys basketball wins first state title since 1925 |url=https://lacrossetribune.com/sports/local/preps/no-1-la-crosse-central-boys-basketball-wins-first-state-title-since-1925/article_0a683a76-ea3a-5625-872d-778dba57b06c.html |website=[[La Crosse Tribune]] |access-date=June 14, 2021 |date=December 30, 2017}} In his junior season, Davis averaged 23 points and 9 rebounds per game, earning ''La Crosse Tribune'' Player of the Year honors.{{cite web |last=Sommerfeldt |first=Todd |title=All-Tribune boys basketball: La Crosse Central's Johnny Davis is player of the year |url=https://lacrossetribune.com/sports/local/preps/all-tribune-boys-basketball-la-crosse-centrals-johnny-davis-is-player-of-the-year/article_67ee1159-6ee6-561d-ae84-c95cfaa222b2.html |website=[[La Crosse Tribune]] |access-date=June 14, 2021 |date=April 7, 2019}} As a senior, he averaged 27.4 points and 9.2 rebounds per game.{{cite web |last=Lee |first=Eric |title=High school basketball: Johnny Davis dazzled for La Crosse Central, looks to do the same for Badgers |url=https://lacrossetribune.com/sports/local/preps/high-school-basketball-johnny-davis-dazzled-for-la-crosse-central-looks-to-do-the-same/article_bff330b3-7652-522b-8cbd-10596ab38141.html |website=[[La Crosse Tribune]] |access-date=June 14, 2021 |date=April 12, 2020}} He was named [[Wisconsin Mr. Basketball]] and repeated as ''La Crosse Tribune'' Player of the Year.{{cite web |last=Sommerfeldt |first=Todd |title=All-Tribune boys basketball: Johnny Davis is player of the year |url=https://lacrossetribune.com/sports/local/preps/all-tribune-boys-basketball-johnny-davis-is-player-of-the-year/article_95c04708-2e8c-5dcc-a81e-c774e2673d04.html |website=[[La Crosse Tribune]] |access-date=June 14, 2021 |date=April 20, 2020}} Davis left as his school's all-time leading scorer with 2,158 career points.{{cite web |last=McNamara |first=Jon |title=WBCA tabs Wisconsin signee Jonathan Davis as Mr. Basketball |url=https://wisconsin.rivals.com/news/wbca-tabs-wisconsin-signee-jonathan-davis-as-player-of-the-year |website=[[Rivals.com|Rivals]] |access-date=June 13, 2021 |date=March 17, 2020}} He committed to playing college basketball for [[Wisconsin Badgers men's basketball|Wisconsin]] over offers from [[Marquette Golden Eagles men's basketball|Marquette]], [[Iowa Hawkeyes men's basketball|Iowa]] and [[Minnesota Golden Gophers men's basketball|Minnesota]], among others.{{cite web |last=Potrykus |first=Jeff |title=Davis brothers from La Crosse commit to play basketball for Wisconsin |url=https://www.jsonline.com/story/sports/college/uw/2019/06/15/davis-brothers-la-crosse-commit-play-basketball-wisconsin/1469654001/ |website=[[Milwaukee Journal Sentinel]] |access-date=June 14, 2021 |date=June 15, 2019}} Davis also played [[American football|football]] for La Crosse Central as a [[quarterback]].{{cite web |last=Sommerfeldt |first=Todd |title=High school football: Johnny Davis left significant mark at La Crosse Central |url=https://lacrossetribune.com/sports/local/preps/football/high-school-football-johnny-davis-left-significant-mark-at-la-crosse-central/article_356d80aa-a67b-5e12-9df8-78354ab660a2.html |website=[[La Crosse Tribune]] |access-date=June 14, 2021 |date=October 30, 2019}} In his senior season, he earned Large Schools First Team All-State honors and won the Dave Krieg Award as the most outstanding senior quarterback in Wisconsin.{{cite web |last=Wilson |first=Travis |title=Johnny Davis of La Crosse Central selected to receive Dave Krieg Award |url=https://www.wissports.net/news_article/show/1066149 |website=Wisconsin Sports Network |access-date=June 14, 2021 |date=November 20, 2019}} ==College career== On February 2, 2021, Davis scored a freshman season-high 17 points, shooting 6-of-7 from the field, in a 72–56 win over [[2020–21 Penn State Nittany Lions basketball team|Penn State]].{{cite web |last=Vazquez |first=Raul |title=The "sky's the limit" for Wisconsin freshman wing Jonathan Davis |url=https://wisconsin.rivals.com/news/the-sky-s-the-limit-for-wisconsin-freshman-wing-jonathan-davis |website=[[Rivals.com|Rivals]] |access-date=June 14, 2021 |date=February 4, 2021}} As a freshman, he came off the bench, averaging seven points and 4.1 rebounds per game while leading his team with 34 steals.{{cite web |last=Polzin |first=Jim |title=Badgers freshman Jonathan Davis earns tryout with US U19 National Team |url=https://madison.com/wsj/sports/college/basketball/men/badgers-freshman-jonathan-davis-earns-tryout-with-us-u19-national-team/article_c0feef39-595a-57fb-94f7-2d24f3d882c5.html |website=[[Wisconsin State Journal]] |access-date=June 14, 2021 |date=May 6, 2021}} On November 23, 2021, Davis scored 30 points in a 65–63 upset of [[2021–22 Houston Cougars men's basketball team|Houston]].{{cite news |title=Wisconsin holds off No. 12 Houston with 65–63 upset |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=401376724 |access-date=November 29, 2021 |work=[[ESPN]] |agency=[[Associated Press]] |date=November 23, 2021}} He scored a career-high 37 points and had 14 rebounds on January 3, 2022, in a 74–69 upset of [[2021–22 Purdue Boilermakers men's basketball team|Purdue]].{{cite news |last=Manderfeld |first=Noah |title=Johnny Davis scores 37 as Wisconsin pulls off the upset, beats No. 3 Purdue on the road |url=https://www.wsaw.com/2022/01/04/johnny-davis-scores-35-wisconsin-pulls-off-upset-beats-no-3-purdue-road/ |access-date=January 3, 2022 |work=WSAW |date=January 3, 2022}} As a sophomore, he averaged 19.7 points and 8.2 rebounds per game. Davis was named [[Big Ten Conference Men's Basketball Player of the Year|Big Ten Player of the Year]].{{cite press release|url=https://bigten.org/news/2022/3/8/2021-22-big-ten-mens-basketball-postseason-honors-announced.aspx|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220308180525/https://bigten.org/news/2022/3/8/2021-22-big-ten-mens-basketball-postseason-honors-announced.aspx|url-status=dead|archive-date=March 8, 2022|title=2021-22 Big Ten Men's Basketball Postseason Honors Announced|publisher=[[Big Ten Conference]] |date=March 8, 2022 |access-date=March 8, 2022}} On March 31, 2022, Davis declared for the [[2022 NBA draft]], forgoing his remaining college eligibility.{{Cite web |last=Givony |first=Jonathan |date=March 31, 2022 |title=Badgers' Davis to enter NBA draft, hire agent |url=https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/33640802 |access-date=March 31, 2022 |website=ESPN.com |language=en}} ==Professional career== ===Washington Wizards (2022–2025)=== [[File:Johnny Davis Wizards 2022.jpg|thumb|left|Davis at the [[Washington Wizards]] media day in 2022]] Davis was selected with the tenth overall pick by the [[Washington Wizards]] in the [[2022 NBA draft]].{{cite web |last=Filyo |first=Jackson |date=June 24, 2022 |title=Wizards select Johnny Davis with 10th pick in 2022 NBA Draft |url=https://www.nba.com/wizards/wizards-select-johnny-davis-10th-pick-2022-nba-draft |access-date=July 14, 2022 |website=NBA.com}} Davis joined the Wizards' [[2022 NBA Summer League]] roster.{{Cite web |title=Washington Wizards 2022 NBA2K23 Summer League Roster {{!}} NBA.com |url=https://www.nba.com/summer-league/2022/vegas/team/1610612764/wizards |access-date=July 28, 2022 |website=NBA.com}} In his Summer League debut, Davis scored six points on 1-for-11 shooting in a 99–105 loss to the [[Detroit Pistons]].{{Cite web |date=July 10, 2022 |title=Detroit Pistons vs Washington Wizards Jul 9, 2022 Box Scores {{!}} NBA.com |url=https://www.nba.com/game/det-vs-was-1522200013/box-score |access-date=July 28, 2022 |website=NBA.com}} On February 6, 2025, Davis was traded to the [[Memphis Grizzlies]] along with [[Marvin Bagley III]] in a three-team deal involving [[Marcus Smart]],{{Cite web |title=Wizards add Marcus Smart in multi-team deal with Grizzlies, Kings |url=https://www.nba.com/news/wizards-grizzlies-kings-smart-laravia-len-trade?m= |access-date=2025-02-07 |website=NBA.com |language=en}} but was waived on February 21, 2025, without appearing in a game for the Grizzlies.{{Cite web |last=Radcliffe |first=J. R. |title=Former Wisconsin star Johnny Davis released by Memphis Grizzlies after being traded by Washington Wizards |url=https://www.jsonline.com/story/sports/college/uw/2025/02/21/johnny-davis-ex-wisconsin-badgers-star-released-by-memphis-grizzlies/79441563007/ |access-date=2025-02-21 |website=Journal Sentinel |language=en-US}} ===Westchester Knicks (2025)=== On March 1, 2025, Davis signed with the [[Westchester Knicks]] of the [[NBA G League]].{{Cite web |title=WESTCHESTER KNICKS ACQUIRE JOHNNY DAVIS |url=https://westchester.gleague.nba.com/news/westchester-knicks-acquire-johnny-davis |access-date=2025-03-08 |website=Westchester Knicks |language=en}} ===Wisconsin Herd (2025–2026)=== On October 8, 2025, the [[Wisconsin Herd]] acquired Davis' player rights from the Westchester Knicks. In exchange, the Herd sent the rights to Diego Bernard and Jalen Lewis, along with a pick in the 2026 NBA G League Player Draft and International Draft to Westchester.{{cite web |last=Stumbris |first=Kedrick |title=Former Wisconsin Badgers guard Johnny Davis acquired by Milwaukee Bucks affiliate |work=Wisconsin Badgers On SI |date=2025-10-08 |url=https://www.si.com/college/wisconsin/basketball/former-wisconsin-badgers-guard-johnny-davis-acquired-by-milwaukee-bucks |access-date=2025-12-05}} ===Körfez Basket (2026–present)=== On June 19, 2026, Davis signed with [[Körfez Basket]] of the [[Basketbol Süper Ligi]] (BSL).{{Cite tweet |user=glintkorfez |number=2085721687681552690 |title=Hoş geldin, Johnny Davis! }} ==National team career== Davis represented the [[United States men's national under-19 basketball team|United States]] at the [[2021 FIBA Under-19 Basketball World Cup|2021 FIBA Under-19 World Cup]] in Latvia. He averaged 4.1 points per game, helping his team win the gold medal.{{cite web |last=Schnable |first=Abby |title=Jonathan Davis, Team USA become gold medalists in FIBA U19 World Cup |url=https://madison.com/wsj/sports/college/basketball/men/jonathan-davis-team-usa-become-gold-medalists-in-fiba-u19-world-cup/article_b91ff5db-15af-510a-898f-9af9b936826e.html |website=[[Wisconsin college career at [[Old Dominion Monarchs men's basketball|Old Dominion]]. His twin brother, Jordan, who was his basketball and football teammate in high school, originally played college basketball for Wisconsin{{cite web |last=Lucas |first=Mike |title=Lucas: Johnny Davis pairs quiet confidence with loud game |url=https://uwbadgers.com/news/2020/10/30/mens-basketball-lucas-johnny-davis-pairs-calm-confidence-with-lively-basketball-game.aspx |website=Wisconsin Badgers
